testCases.scenario: Order-01: Send all vendor orders from the tablet POS and review a sent order
testCases.testCase: Log in, build orders in the tablet POS, send all vendor orders, then review an order in the Orders List
testCases.preCondition: Browser open at /login; account 'testing@yopmail.com' exists; tablet POS ordering available for Main Location; vendors have items with PAR levels so an order can be built
testSteps: Click 'Quick Inventory' then 'Inventory' in the sidebar
Enable tablet view (Tablet Preview toggle → 'Exit tablet' appears)
Click 'Review All Orders →' (heading 'Review order before sending')
Click 'Send N orders' (DESTRUCTIVE — submits real vendor orders)
Verify each vendor row shows 'Sent ✓' (real confirmation)
Toggle the 'GORDON' vendor (opens its editor) and click 'Cancel'
View order number 2 and inspect its details
testCases.testData:
Email: testing@yopmail.com
Password: 12345678
Expected confirmation: 5 vendors show 'Sent ✓'
Product sought in order details: Sprite
testCases.expectedResult: Orders are submitted (5 vendors → 'Sent ✓'); the Orders List shows the new Submitted orders; the opened order's details list its product lines
testCases.linkedTestTitle: ORDER-01 — send all vendor orders from the tablet POS and review them
knownDiscrepancies: Confirmation: the literal toast 'Sent 5 orders across 5' is not rendered by the live app; the real confirmation is 5x 'Sent ✓'.
Order details: 'Sprite' is in the SYSCO order, not order #2 (US FOODS); a freshly-sent batch's list order is non-deterministic, so 'order number 2 → Sprite' is unreliable.
